title: Outcome tracking: post-publication defect + partner-feedback log + coverage matrix
context: The project's success metrics are outcome-based, not vanity-metric-based: zero critical defects post-publication, sets actually adopted and given to patients, sets within their review window. Tracking these requires structured artifacts: a post-publication defect log (any embedded advice, factual error, leading question, or missing disclaimer found after merge), a partner-feedback log (aggregate summaries only — no PII), and a coverage matrix (topic x stage cells filled, by review status and currency). These are referenced in the PLAN success metrics table and are a M3 exit criterion.
objective: Create and populate three tracking artifacts: (1) docs/defect-log.yaml — a structured log of post-publication content defects; (2) docs/feedback-log.yaml — a log of aggregate partner feedback summaries (no PII); (3) docs/coverage-matrix.md — a topic x journey-stage grid showing which cells have a published, dual-signed-off, adopted set and whether each is within its review window.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/defect-log.yaml is present with a defined schema (id, setId, discoveredDate, defectType: embedded-advice|factual-error|leading-question|missing-disclaimer|other, description, resolution, resolvedDate) and validates against a defectLogSchema or is self-documented; it is empty at creation (no defects found yet) and ready to receive entries

docs/feedback-log.yaml is present with a defined schema (id, setId, partnerName, feedbackDate, summary, usefulness: positive|negative|mixed|unknown, notes) — no PII fields; it is empty at creation and ready to receive aggregate entries

docs/coverage-matrix.md is present and shows all journey stages (rows) x topic categories (columns) as a Markdown table; each cell shows: empty, draft, dual-signed-off, adopted, or adopted+within-window; the table is populated with the current state of all published sets
All three artifacts are referenced from the repo README as the outcome-tracking data
A brief maintenance note explains how to add entries to each artifact and who is responsible (Steward for adoption/feedback; Maintainer for defects)
resources: PLAN.md (Success metrics table; Sustainability — outcome tracking; M3 exit criteria)
taxonomy/journey-stages.yaml, taxonomy/topics.yaml (qpl-taxonomy-001 — axes for the coverage matrix)
sets/ directory (all published set files — source of coverage matrix data)
